note: The Blandford data review (5 Oct, reports/external_data_review.md): an unexposed horse's auction price cut the within-race error of an older model's BSP forecast by 2.7-3.2% in maidens and novice races, with nothing beyond BSP on the winner. The sales block (sl_, model/blocks/sales.py) reads Timeform's record of each horse's sales before it raced (foal, yearling, breeze-up, store; data/external/timeform_sales.csv.gz from the scraper's horse files), by name and foaling year, and the price against the field. main_sl is the served main (the base, cached) plus the block, at the served recipe, scored on the price forecast, the rule and the owner's staking (GBP250 to win at expected CLV >= 0/3/5%). Live gap: the files stop in July 2025, so this year's two-year-olds have no record until a Timeform horse feed serves one.
